new_cases.title: Direct entry without assessment
new_cases.fixture: Fresh synthetic adult visitor, adult status already declared; no account, CFM answers or payment. Use only details actually supplied in the fresh test chat. Do not import Jordan or a prior proposed starting note.
new_cases.procedure: After installation and Mike's explicit fresh-chat rerun request, use Q07. Let Mike supply participant replies and separately labeled TEST CONTROLLER EVENT results; Steward presents fictional UI/choices, never supplies those events. Group needed setup choices, wait for acknowledgment and controller confirmation, preserve partial states, then return to the original concern. Real application criteria require separate authorized implemented sandbox execution.
expected: No card, faith profession, church or assessment prerequisite; no repeat adult question when declared.

Name/email establish input only. Notices are identified test material, not approved production terms. Required participant choices are actual responses, never assumed; optional permissions remain ungranted unless selected.

A reported link click is not verification. Verification-only events do not imply acknowledgment, MFA, account, Free grant/container or saved content. Applicable authentication/access controls persist.

Only explicit tester events/authorized harness confirmations establish scoped simulated results with supplied prerequisites; Steward cannot generate them. Batched valid results are allowed; missing results remain pending.
After valid successful setup, brief simulated acknowledgment and useful help on the original concern, without restarting intake. No invented scores or life statements.
A note/Blueprint wording needs its appropriate exact participant choice and a separate save confirmation. Account setup approves/saves neither.
Preserve the prior failed owner report. Evaluate actual fresh messages only; no correction PASS or application PASS without its respective executed evidence.
